Chapter 6518: It’S Been A Tough Life

Chapter 6518: It’s Been A Tough Life

“The two of you are bastards.” The skull thought about it and all signs pointed at Li Qiye conspiring with that person. Too many coincidences took place.

“Cursing for no reason.” Li Qiye smiled.

“I’m being nice right now.” The skull said: “We picked a side and fought to the death. All that struggling only to find that you two were on the same side? I died for nothing then.”

“Not for nothing, you are free now.” Li Qiye said.

“Bah, if I had known, I would have done nothing and let the young ones fight instead.” The skull said.

“This is all speculation. I don’t think you would be passive in a do-over.” Li Qiye said.

The skull thought about it: “Only if I had solid proof, then everyone just needed to posture a bit instead of fighting.”

“I myself don’t know what will happen. It’s too early to tell friends from foes.” Li Qiye said.

“Either way, we’re stuck.” The skull mumbled.

“Do you think it was a disaster or a blessing for you?” Li Qiye asked.

“Depends on how far I can go.” The skull said.

“Not a matter of fate but rather, personal efforts.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Whatever, we got stuck in your game.” The skull knew he would make the same choice again despite the suspicion.

Li Qiye smiled again, not revealing anything.

“There is another guy who left a power here, older than the two of you.” The skull said.

“I’m curious as well, doesn’t look like an acquaintance. We’ll find out soon.” Li Qiye said.

They entered the realm during their conversation and landed on a peak. Li Qiye took a deep breath to feel the area.

Calling it a realm was accurate because it was tiny. Was Old World a major world? No, that would be Three Immortals.

This realm was only the size of a kingdom, one out of millions in Old World. Thus, Li Qiye sensed the whole thing in no time at all.

It was prosperous but not in the mortal sense. The mortal coil included an abundance of emotions and desires twisting together, culminating in a complex and merciless world.

This one had a remarkably stable foundation built on simplicity and sincerity. This unadorned authenticity was a return to nature and harmony.

The realm was filled with kindness and love instead of hatred. It invited all travelers, regardless of who they were, to stop and appreciate what this realm had to offer.

“Who nourished this world? It is special and beautiful than any paradise.” The skull commented.

“From the heart.” Li Qiye smiled and entered a town.

There was no dao power or laws here, only a natural aura. Those who lived here were calm and peaceful, regardless of age and gender. They carried themselves with poise and serenity.

Mortals had a long lifespan, often a century or longer. Of course, this was only the blink of an eye to cultivators.

Nevertheless, they lived well during the short span, untouched by illness or hardship. Their vitality was pure and strong until death.

Li Qiye’s arrival attracted attention. However, it came with a smile from the heart since they had no prejudice against outsiders.

He looked like a mortal. His frame and vitality looked weaker compared to theirs.

“Young man, you don’t look so well.” Passersby and elderly folks sitting on their doorstep worried about him.

“It’s been a tough life.” Li Qiye casually answered.

“Really? Elaborate and we can find a way to help.” An elder spoke with genuine concern, taking his words seriously.

“I haven’t been eating well.” He smiled.

“Where are you from? Is the food not good there?” Those nearby were shocked to hear this.

“I don’t remember.” Li Qiye shook his head: “I’m just happening to be walking by here.”
